name: io.github.montygovernance.memocat
description: Private, self-hosted long-term memory, semantic search, vector RAG, live updates, and governance for Claude Desktop.
long_description: MemoCat gives Claude persistent memory backed by a locally managed or user-configured Montycat engine. Store, update, delete, browse, and semantically search memories while keeping the database and embeddings under your control.

montycat_uri.title: Existing Montycat URI (optional)
montycat_uri.description: Leave blank to let MemoCat find or start a local engine. For an existing engine use montycat://user:password@host:port/store.

montycat_tls.title: Use TLS for existing engine
montycat_tls.description: Enable only when the configured Montycat engine presents a trusted TLS certificate.

default_keyspace.title: Default memory keyspace
default_keyspace.description: Memory namespace used when Claude does not select a scope or keyspace.

autostart.title: Local engine startup mode
autostart.description: Use auto for native/Docker setup, or off to require an engine that is already running.

tools.name: memocat_semantic_search
tools.description: Search memories by semantic similarity.

tools.name: memocat_remember
tools.description: Store one persistent memory.

tools.name: memocat_remember_bulk
tools.description: Store multiple memories.

tools.name: memocat_recall
tools.description: Recall memories by key or field filter.

tools.name: memocat_list_memories
tools.description: Browse stored memories.

tools.name: memocat_update
tools.description: Update an existing memory.

tools.name: memocat_forget
tools.description: Permanently delete one memory.

tools.name: memocat_await_memory_change
tools.description: Wait for a live memory change notification.

tools.name: memocat_install_engine
tools.description: Install the Montycat engine on this computer and start it.

tools.name: memocat_list_keyspaces
tools.description: List visible memory keyspaces.

tools.name: memocat_create_keyspace
tools.description: Create a memory keyspace.

tools.name: memocat_remove_keyspace
tools.description: Permanently delete a memory keyspace.

tools.name: memocat_enable_semantic
tools.description: Enable semantic search for a keyspace.

tools.name: memocat_enable_external_vectors
tools.description: Configure caller-supplied vectors for a keyspace.

tools.name: memocat_semantic_status
tools.description: Inspect semantic search configuration and backfill status.

tools.name: memocat_reembed_semantic
tools.description: Clear and rebuild a keyspace's semantic vectors.

tools.name: memocat_disable_semantic
tools.description: Disable semantic search and optionally delete vectors.

tools.name: memocat_start_snapshots
tools.description: Start scheduled snapshots for an in-memory keyspace.

tools.name: memocat_stop_snapshots
tools.description: Stop scheduled snapshots for an in-memory keyspace.

tools.name: memocat_clean_snapshots
tools.description: Delete snapshot files for an in-memory keyspace.

tools.name: memocat_policy_view
tools.description: View the configured owner's effective governance policy.

tools.name: memocat_policy_history
tools.description: View governance history visible to the configured owner.

tools.name: memocat_policy_explain
tools.description: Explain whether a governed action would be allowed.
